conbody.p: Collision warning will alert the driver with the emergency steering warning light blinking (), warning message, steering wheel vibration and an audible warning.
Collision warning will be activated in the following conditions.

li.p: Your driving speed: Approximately 40–145 km/h (25–90 mph)
Oncoming vehicle or powered two-wheeler speed: Approximately above 10 km/h (6 mph)
Relative speed: Approximately below 200 km/h (124 mph)
When your vehicle and the oncoming vehicle or powered two-wheeler are moving in opposite directions.
Within a certain period of time after the system determines that the vehicle has departed from the lane.
When the target enters the operating area of the function.
When driving on a straight road.
